parameters.content:
## MNN Drug Enrichment (P0+P1)

Chat or POST `/webhook/mnn-drug-enrichment` with `{"product":"..."}`.

Pipeline: DeepSeek preprocess → SearXNG (×3) → Aggregate (+fallback searches, prefer official hosts) → DeepSeek postprocess → Validate (+1 parse retry) → Finalize.

HTTP retries: DeepSeek×2 + SearXNG (3 tries). Empty search / LLM errors → structured JSON (`status`,`error_code`,`retryable`). Grounded only: no MNN without snippets.
